title: Credit and Risk Officer
description:
ü IFSC Banking Unit (IBU) at GIFT City is the only Foreign Branch YES Bank has. Through this branch, Bank’s business in foreign currency e.g. FC bonds/loans to Indian/foreign companies, FCY institutional borrowings and FCY deposit raising from individuals/foreign corporates is done. Therefore, to that extent, IBU holds very important position from overall Bank’s perspective. IBU is governed by RBI (as home country regulator) and IFSCA (as host country regulator). The position requires dealing with various business units, external stakeholders like regulator/peer Banks, control and support functions of the Bank, support formulation \& implementation product/ policies/ support finalization of business strategy and work towards business development and ensuring the optimal conduct of the Branch.
   

  

 ü Advances book of the branch has surpassed INR 8,000 crore with more than 400\+ credit relationships and this additional head shall support Credit and Risk Head in undertaking initial evaluation/discussion of credit proposals, assess Term Sheet / CAMs and providing inputs on facility \& security structure, legal, regulatory and credit policy related aspects. Relationship team spread over the across YBL locations required support/guidance in servicing existing IBU asset relationships and NTB onboarding from proposal initiation stage to disbursement and also post disbursement monitoring / tracking.
   

  

**Strategy \& Planning**
* Coordinate with BUs for disbursement requirement of the sanctioned credit line and ensure adequate funding arrangements in consultation with BSMG.
* Driving potential opportunities and ensure quick response on the deal structure and other queries that meets regulatory requirements and internal guidelines by way of initiating discussions with Business Risk Compliance Product Legal and External Counsel and other internal External stake holders for the closure of the deal. Building healthy relationship with internal stake holders for generating more business for the unit


**Policies, Processes \& Procedures**
 To ensure implementation of all internal as well as external processes and policies as per guidelines maintain credit quality assessment, follow up on overdue principle, interest and fee payments, follow up for exception and ensure closure of exceptions.
   

  

**Risk and Internal Control**
 To conduct Credit related operations as per the laid down process and guidelines Potential loss events or errors to be observed and mitigate. To Ensur timely submission of regulatory and statutory reports Monitoring exception reports and timely follow\-up for closure
   

  

**People Management**
* Impart knowledge on IBU product policies. Set performance objectives and provide regular feedback \& guidance.


 Impart training to various business groups on IBU product propositions to build awareness on IBU product policies.
   

  

**Documentation \& Compliance**
* Closely work with compliance team on implementation of various regulatorily prescribed policies/product enablers.
* Support Operations/product team in implementing new product processes, preparation of PPAC notes/review.


**Experience**
**Essential: 7\+ years of experience.**
**Preferred: 10\+ years of experience.**

title: Compliance Officer
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building Tomorrow, today**
 At CoinDCX, we believe ‘CHANGE STARTS TOGETHER’. You are the driving force that will help us make Web3 accessible to all.
   

  

 In the last six years, we have skyrocketed from being India’s first crypto unicorn to carrying a community of over 125 million with us. To continue maximising the adoption and acceleration of Web3, we are now focused on developing cutting\-edge products, addressing accessibility and security challenges, and bridging the gap between people and Web3 technologies.
   

  

 While we go ahead and keep dominating the Web3 world, we would like to HODL you on our team! Join our team of passionate innovators who are breaking barriers and building the future of Web3\. Together, we will make the complex simple, the inaccessible accessible, and the impossible possible. Boost your innovation to an ALL TIME HIGH with us!
   

  

**Inside CoinDCX’s Compliance Team**
 Our Compliance team ensures CoinDCX operates with integrity and within regulatory frameworks, navigating the complex world of blockchain with precision. We’re dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of compliance to protect our business and users. If you’re detail\-oriented and have a strong understanding of regulatory landscapes, join us in safeguarding the future of digital finance.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Compliance Officer (“CO”) will be responsible for establishing, implementing and independently overseeing the regulatory compliance framework for the Company’s Broker\-Dealer and Introducing Broker operations in GIFT IFSC. The CO will monitor adherence to applicable IFSCA regulations, circulars, directions and other regulatory requirements and provide independent compliance advice, monitoring and challenge to the business.
   

  

**You need to be a HODLer of these**
* A professional qualification or postgraduate degree/postgraduate diploma of at least one year in Finance, Law, Accountancy, Business Management, Commerce, Economics, Capital Markets, Banking, Insurance, Actuarial Science, FinTech, Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics; or CFA / FRM; or such other relevant qualification as may be specified by IFSCA. Provided that minimum two years of experience in the financial services market. Experience in another field may be considered with at least two years of work experience in a compliance\-related role or function .
* Alternatively, a graduate degree in any discipline with at least five years of work experience in the financial services market, in accordance with applicable IFSCA requirements.
* A recognised Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) are also specifically eligible
* Relevant experience in capital markets compliance, securities/brokerage regulation, regulatory compliance, AML/CFT or financial\-services compliance is preferred.
* Strong understanding of IFSCA regulations, Broker\-Dealer requirements, regulatory reporting, client protection and compliance\-monitoring frameworks.
* Strong regulatory interpretation, analytical, monitoring and documentation skills.
* Ability to exercise independent judgement, challenge and escalation on regulatory and compliance matters.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills, including interaction with regulators, exchanges, auditors and senior management.
* High standards of integrity, independence and regulatory judgement.
* Must be based out of the IFSC, as required under applicable IFSCA regulations.
* Must complete certification course " Regulatory Framework for Capital Market Intermediaries in IFSC (ICSI) " as prescribed by IFSCA.


**You will be mining through these tasks**
* Establish, implement and maintain an effective regulatory compliance framework for the Broker\-Dealer and Introducing Broker activities and monitor ongoing compliance with the IFSCA (Capital Market Intermediaries) Regulations, applicable Broker\-Dealer requirements, exchange requirements and circulars and directions.
* Act as a key point of contact for IFSCA, recognised stock exchanges (India INX/ NSE IX) and other relevant authorities on compliance\-related matters, as applicable.
* Maintain a regulatory obligations and compliance calendar and oversee timely completion of regulatory filings, returns, disclosures, certifications and other periodic obligations.
* Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the business products, processes, policies and control framework and ensure relevant policies, procedures and SOPs are updated accordingly.
* Oversee compliance with applicable requirements relating to client onboarding, KYC/CDD, AML/CFT, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring and record keeping, in coordination with designated AML personnel and relevant operational teams.
* Oversee compliance with applicable net worth, capital adequacy and other prudential requirements, in coordination with Finance and Compliance.
* Conduct periodic compliance monitoring, testing and reviews to assess adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies and escalate regulatory breaches or material compliance risks, and track corrective actions to closure.
* Review and provide compliance advice/sign\-off, as appropriate, for new products, material process changes, client journeys and third\-party arrangements prior to implementation.
* Monitor compliance with requirements relating to client funds and securities/assets, segregation, conflicts of interest, investor protection and conduct of business, wherever applicable.
* Review applicable client agreements, disclosures, risk disclosures and regulatory communications from a compliance perspective.
* Coordinate regulatory inspections and compliance audits, including tracking observations, remediation and maintaining appropriate records to support regulatory and audit readiness.
* Provide periodic compliance reporting to the Board and/or relevant committees, as applicable and provide periodic regulatory and compliance training and promote awareness of applicable regulatory obligations.
* Maintain appropriate compliance records and documentary evidence to support regulatory and audit readiness.
* Provide independent compliance advice and challenge business, operations, product and technology teams.


**Are you the one? Our missing block**
* You are curious and knowledge\-driven, with a strong interest in capital markets, broker\-dealer activities, and regulatory developments, and are always eager to deepen your understanding and stay ahead in an evolving landscape.
* You are proactive and analytical, with the ability to navigate evolving regulatory requirements, identify potential risks, and contribute to building robust compliance frameworks in a dynamic environment.


**Perks That Empower You**
 Our benefits are designed to make a lasting impact on your life, giving you the freedom to create a work\-life balance that truly suits you.
   

  

* Design Your Own Benefit: Tailor your perk package to fit your unique needs. Whether you’re eyeing a new gadget or welcoming a furry friend into your life, our flexible benefits ensure that you can prioritise what matters most to you.
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: We believe in the power of well\-being. Take the time you need to recharge, knowing that your health is our priority. With unlimited wellness leaves, you can return refreshed, ready to build and grow.
* Mental Wellness Support: Your mental health is as important as your professional growth. Benefit from access to health experts, free counseling sessions, monthly wellness workshops, and regular team outings, all designed to help you stay balanced and connected.
* Bi\-Weekly Learning Sessions: These sessions are more than just updates—they’re opportunities to fuel your growth. Stay ahead with the latest industry knowledge, sharpen your skills, and accelerate your career in an ever\-evolving landscape.

title: Analyst - Customs & Logistics
description:
Responsible for Customs Clearance \& Inland transportation /delivery of and all Import \& Export Consignment. by Air \& Sea from various ports in India.
   

  

 Regular Coordination with Customs Broker / shipping line /Freight forwarder for import/ Export shipments
   

  

 EXIM activities \& import of capital goods under various duty\-free schemes \& issuance of Licenses under various import/export promotion schemes in coordination with various government agencies. Overall, responsible for various export / import / logistics and licensing activities.
   

  

 Customs Clearance, EPCG License, Project Import license, Customs, Duty Drawback, various Exports Incentives etc., under Concessional Imports Duty Exemption under various customs notification and FTA, compliance of all customs matters.
   

  

 Maintaining Liaising with Sr. Govt. Official.
   

  

 Initiate for various Cost\-effective project.
   

  

* Knowledge of Import \& Export Consignment customs Clearance Air \& Sea.
* Follow up with shipping line Freight forwarder for regular import/ Export shipments and with CHA for import clearance.
* Good knowledge of Export under self\-sealing process \& factory stuffing container.
* Coordination for Import/ Export Transport from port to Plant and Plant to Port.
* Knowledge of Durable packaging material re\- import duty free and time line of Tracking.
* Responsibility of Service provider invoice processing and Service validation
* Knowledge of Direct Port Delivery (DPD)Import customs clearance.
* Knowledge of customs duty calculation and payment processing
* Knowledge of registration of EPCG, Advance license \& preparation Bond/BG
* Knowledge of BG/Bond cancellation with customs
* Finalization of provisional BOE and Shipping bill from customs
* Knowledge of Customs clearance of capital goods/ Machinery under various duty\-free schemes like, EPCG License, Project Import license \& Advance license.
* Knowledge of Duty Drawback, various Exports Incentives etc., under Concessional Imports Duty Exemption under various customs notification and FTA,
* Knowledge of statutory compliance under various Custom laws, FTP rules, procedures and regulations including compliance with Customs duty and Import incentive scheme,
* Good communication Skill of drafting the reply letter to Customs \& Liaison with Government Bodies like customs, DGFT, IGST department etc. .
* Dealing with Custom authorities for the assessment/Examination \& litigation proceedings in close co\-ordination with local CHA.


* Any Graduate preferably with MBA in Import /Exports.
* Work Experience\-( 8\-10 yrs )
* \+5yrs Customs Operations and additional working knowledge on HS classification / FTA analysis
+ Industry Type \-Automotive, Engineering, Electronics, industry
+ Worked in any CoE environment, Operations / FTA HS Classification (preferred)
